content.text: Staying in bed is a super common fight at this age. The one thing to try tonight is a calm, boring "walk back." Do the same short bedtime routine, then tell them once, "Stay in your bed, I'll see you in the morning." Each time they get up, quietly and with no chat, walk them straight back to bed. Keep your face and voice dull so getting up isn't a fun game. It can take a lot of repeats the first few nights, so staying steady matters most.
